'''Nattus Breely''' was a former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at [[Titan Base]]. He had a younger cousin named [[Ty Breely]].<ref name="OSG" />
